name: csp-wa-server
description: Baileys-based WhatsApp HTTP server for CSP platform (no Chromium — direct WebSocket protocol)
_why_baileys_6_7_23: Stay on the 6.x line, but on a PATCHED release (>=6.7.22): 6.7.18 and older
carry the published message-spoofing advisory GHSA-qvv5-jq5g-4cgg, which is
not acceptable on a machine that messages bank customers.
6.7.20+ ship as ES Modules, so wa_server.js loads Baileys with dynamic
import() instead of require() — that works from CommonJS on Node 20, which is
what CSP machines run (a plain require() of ESM dies there with
ERR_REQUIRE_ESM). Range stays <7 on purpose: 7.x is release-candidate only
and adds a native whatsapp-rust-bridge, not something to push to unattended
